environment.mode: fresh CLI processes; warm filesystem cache after saved warmup; no cache dropping or synthetic load; shared host external load recorded per sample; service stopped during restored samples to prevent competing reconciliation

limitations: Fixture actors are real idle OS processes, not provider models; session records are seeded explicitly.

Production profile helper CPU remains unavailable. External Linux wait4 rusage independently measures the CLI and its synchronously reaped helper tree; provider payload is absent. This is not a speed acceptance verdict.
The service lifecycle is real. It is quiesced before snapshots so it cannot consume the ps transitions.
No worker polling implementation or optimization is included. No unit run is needed for baseline-only work.

rusage.scope: CLI plus synchronously reaped descendants; isolated service stopped; no runner payload
